title: Flow Library: Add-on Flows section, source badges, dimmed uninstalled tiles, and paid Gumroad tiles
description: Four changes to the Flow Library, all landing in MpiFlowLibrary.js and the shared MpiTileSheet primitive, so they ship as one pass. 1: a bottom section headed Add-on Flows, holding every package Flow regardless of mediaType, separated from the built-in media sections. Label chosen by Fabio 2026-09-19 - it names DELIVERY, not authorship, because Head Swap and DramaBox are Mad Pony Flows sold as packages and would be mislabelled as third-party. 2: a source flag on package tiles, reusing the TILE_FLAGS sparkle system the Model Library already uses and the Flow Library passes nothing to today. 3: uninstalled tiles render desaturated, which needs patchState to toggle a class and not only swap the chip HTML. 4: two hard-coded tiles for the paid Flows, whose Get it button opens a cubric.studio redirect that forwards to the coded Gumroad URL, and which hide once the matching package id is installed. Answers MPI-780 open question 1 - yes, show them as link tiles. Full plan and the decided design in plan.md.
